# Test different debug levels
env OPENAI_API_KEY=test-key-123

# Test debug level 0 (default - no debug output)
! oairt -api-key test-key-123 -debug 0
stderr 'timeout waiting for initial session'

# Test debug level 1 (debug output)
! oairt -api-key test-key-123 -debug 1
stderr 'Error reading from websocket'

# Test debug level 2 (verbose output)
! oairt -api-key test-key-123 -debug 2 -audio-output verbose.pcm
stderr 'Error reading from websocket'
